Woman Found Dead in Madhya Pradesh Home; Husband and Mother-in-Law Accused

A woman was found dead, hanging in her home in Madhya Pradesh, in circumstances described as similar to a previous case involving Twisha Sharma. Police have accused the deceased's husband and mother-in-law of murder. The incident occurred in the same house where Twisha Sharma's death previously took place, with police arriving at the scene.
